senses.sense_definition: A supernatural being that returns from the dead; a ghost or animated corpse.

examples.text: The ancient folklore was filled with stories of a terrifying <w>revenant</w> wandering the hills.
Villagers believed that the vengeful <w>revenant</w> returned to haunt those who had wronged it in life.

senses.sense_definition: A person who returns after a long absence.

examples.text: He felt like a <w>revenant</w> returning to his hometown after forty years abroad.
The family treated the mysterious traveler like a unwelcome <w>revenant</w> who brought back bad memories.

senses.sense_definition: A person or thing considered to be reborn or reincarnated.

examples.text: The young leader was hailed as a political <w>revenant</w> who would restore the nation's former glory.
Many viewed the new musical prodigy as a true <w>revenant</w> of the classical masters.

senses.sense_definition: Returning or coming back, especially as a ghost or memory.

examples.text: On clear nights, she waited for the <w>revenant</w> ghost of her old friend.
The historian traced the <w>revenant</w> influence of the forgotten empire on modern architecture.
